# One variant per configuration, plus a dispatcher over them.
egvariants -o out spec.json
exists out/qkv_small.cu out/qkv_large.cu out/qkv.cu out/manifest.json
grep '"key": "gemm/N=2304/K=8192/w=bf16/out=bf16/epi=\$0"' out/manifest.json
grep '"split_k": 2' out/manifest.json
grep '"sha256": "[0-9a-f]{64}"' out/manifest.json
grep 'extern "C" void qkv_large_launch_c' out/qkv_large.cu
grep 'if \(m <= 8\) \{ qkv_small_launch\(m, x, w, out, ws, stream\)' out/qkv.cu
grep 'qkv_large_launch\(m, x, w, out, stream\)' out/qkv.cu

# A sweep names each variant after its tunables.
egvariants -sweep -o swept attn.json
exists swept/attn_kv128.cu swept/attn_kv1024.cu
grep '"split_kv": 512' swept/manifest.json

# Errors.
! egvariants -o bad missing.json
stderr 'no such file'
! egvariants -o bad baddispatch.json
stderr 'no variant "nope"'
! egvariants spec.json
stderr usage

-- spec.json --
{
  "skinny_gemm": [{"Name": "qkv_small", "N": 2304, "K": 8192, "MaxM": 8, "Weight": "bf16", "Out": "bf16", "SplitK": 2}],
  "tile_gemm": [{"Name": "qkv_large", "N": 2304, "K": 8192, "Weight": "bf16", "Out": "bf16"}],
  "dispatch": [{"name": "qkv", "routes": [{"max": 8, "variant": "qkv_small"}, {"variant": "qkv_large"}]}]
}
-- attn.json --
{
  "paged_attention": [{"Name": "attn", "Hq": 16, "Hkv": 2, "QLen": 1, "Window": 2048, "Page": 1, "Q": "e4m3", "Out": "f32", "QScale": 5.4730064863875}]
}
-- baddispatch.json --
{
  "tile_gemm": [{"Name": "g", "N": 128, "K": 128, "Weight": "bf16", "Out": "f32"}],
  "dispatch": [{"name": "d", "routes": [{"variant": "nope"}]}]
}
